_comment: Served images the boards never offer, by name: the pictures docs/reference/lessons.md marks false, whose own words (printed in the image) state something we do not hold (lessons 7: an image with words in it is copy, under working rule 9). Working rule 11 still holds: none is renamed, deleted or re-encoded, and a page that served one keeps its URL; this list only keeps them out of scripts/image_candidates.py's pools (block 7) and scripts/original_slots.py's inventory (block 7d), through image_candidates.untruthful(). An image whose served ALT states an unproven claim is caught by rule from data/quality/evidence-ledger.json and needs no row here. Each row: the served file, why it is false, the lesson number in lessons.md and where the defect was recorded. Entered 2026-10-07 (Manchester page run, gap G19), from London's Asset Gate (docs/reports/asset-gate-london/README.md A1-A5, swapped out in ab26a887).
